title: Half the memory, twice the speed
summary: The models now run in bfloat16 instead of float32.
points: Same verdicts as before on 99.9 and 100 percent of 1,397 test prompts.
8-bit integer quantisation was tried first and rejected: it broke both encoders.

items: memory held by the four models

title: A harmful category, and retrained adapters
summary: A seventh category, harmful, covers requests no business role justifies, such as discriminatory hiring or weapons. Both adapters were retrained with it.
points: Trained on public harmful prompts in five languages, plus a third as many safe ones so chit-chat is not mistaken for harm.
Training moved to an AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT through ROCm: about 3 minutes per adapter instead of hours on the CPU.

title: Multilingual model and a four-way comparison
summary: Added GLiNER2.5-multi-Decide with its own adapter, trained on the English set, machine translations into French, Spanish, German and Portuguese, and public injections.
points: The demo now compares four models: English and multilingual, each with and without fine-tuning.

title: A fine-tuned ERP adapter
summary: A 30 MB LoRA adapter on GLiNER2.5-Decide, trained on about 500 synthetic ERP prompts with each user's role in the input.
